title: Built Human-Controlled Browser and Mailbox Automation Tools
summary: Built guarded automation foundations for job-application preparation and review-first mailbox operations while preserving explicit user control over consequential actions.
context: The private workspace separates browser interfaces, durable backend services, sensitive data, and public release boundaries. Product adoption is not claimed; the candidate focuses on architecture and safety controls.
contributions: Implemented browser-assisted job discovery and application preparation with explicit user control over uploads and submission.
Built durable profile, resume, extraction, fit-analysis, and application-package services behind typed contracts.
Created review-first mailbox workflows with authenticated operations, durable jobs, immutable plans, fresh-state checks, backup, and bounded cleanup.
Protected sensitive credentials and data through encryption, retention rules, confirmation boundaries, and reversible operations.
Established fail-closed workspace separation, extensive automated tests, extension builds, schema checks, and proportional CI controls.
